correctness.rationale: The ten-vertex definition and 1024 subsets are fully reconstructed by two independent implementations. Every face-poset cover is tested for matching acyclicity, yielding critical-cell counts (1,4) at r=1, (1,1) at r=2/3, (1,15,4) at r=4, and single-dimensional critical families at r=5–9. At r=4 an exact signed 15×4 integral Morse boundary has a maximal determinant-one minor on rows 2,4,9,13; its four primitive attaching maps cancel in a 2-connected CW complex, proving the eleven-sphere wedge. A full augmented \(\mathbb F_2\) chain reduction gives the eight barcode types. An independent chain builder reproduces all reduced Betti groups over primes 2,3,5,7 and separately checks rank-one persistence from r=2 to r=4. The proof is finite and confined to the Petersen graph.

value.rationale: It is a natural complete homotopy-and-persistence classification of the component-size filtration on the canonical girth-five cubic graph, not an isolated high-parameter increment. The long [2,5) third-homology barcode and ten additional classes born at r=4 expose inclusion behavior not determined by the already published r=2 sphere; the integral degree-four cancellation is structural, not a mere Betti count. A complete exact finite invariant with a motivated object is useful without a claimed general-family or downstream theorem.
